claims.statement: The revised Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive requires preparation for reuse, recycling, and resource recovery, particularly phosphorus and nitrogen, subject to viability and safety.
EU fertilizing-product rules provide conformity and end-of-waste pathways for recovered materials including struvite, while Polish sludge use requires specified tests and dose evidence.
Demand hypothesis: plants and technology vendors will pay for forward buyer evidence that improves recovery-project approval and utilization.

contrary_evidence: The directive leaves national and local valorization choices and considers economic viability.
Direct sludge use can be cheaper than nutrient recovery where legally allowed.

economics.acquisition_route: Demand hypothesis: recovery-technology vendors will sponsor evidence rooms that shorten their customer's offtake work
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 80 plants at 30000 PLN yearly plus 2m PLN success fees yields 4.4m PLN revenue; 25% EBITDA at a 5x value could exceed 5m PLN in 6-8 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly, expecting slow public-sector cycles and expert subcontractors
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 60-75% after lab-data onboarding and procurement support; no treatment assets owned
economics.payback: Economics hypothesis: three paid pilots at 30000 PLN each recover setup capital in 18-24 months
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 20000-50000 PLN yearly per plant plus 1-3% of contracted offtake value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Continuous sampling, annual reporting, new recovery lines, and multi-year offtake renewals

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Longitudinal contaminant and nutrient data, buyer acceptance limits, and bankable realized offtake terms
fingerprint.customer: Municipal and industrial wastewater plants, recovery technology vendors, fertilizer manufacturers, and qualified agricultural users
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Water utilities, environmental engineering firms, accredited labs, fertilizer advisers, and public-procurement consultants
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Owner-authorized capacity profile, lab-history normalization, land or buyer eligibility, conformity milestones, tender-ready data room, and forward offtake matching
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Plant or technology vendor pays an annual data room fee and a success fee when forward offtake is contracted
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A plant must plan resource recovery or sludge use but lacks an evidence-ready buyer and price signal for future output

founder_fit: Asset-light exposure to a capital-intensive transition
Can use AI for evidence-room assembly

structure.commercial_archetype: Forward resource-capacity marketplace and evidence room
structure.control_point: Plant-authorized multi-year quality history linked to a reserved output right
structure.critical_dependency: Public buyers and plants must permit the workflow, and every route must meet fertilizer, waste, soil, and procurement rules

thesis: Wastewater operators authorize publication of future phosphorus, nitrogen, struvite, or compliant sludge-derived output with historical lab evidence; fertilizer makers and land users reserve capacity before production. Demand hypothesis: repeat test history and pre-sold offtake can de-risk recovery projects without the platform financing equipment.
title: Wastewater Nutrient Capacity and Evidence Exchange
uncertainties: Value of forward offtake to lenders
